<thought>The spectral data (¹H NMR three singlets integrating to 3 H, 6 H, 3 H; ¹³C NMR showing a carbonyl at ~161 ppm, two sp² carbons at ~144 and ~130 ppm, and four distinct methyl carbons) together with the exact mass (127.0997 Da) correspond to the molecular formula C₇H₁₃NO. A structure that fits all observations is an N‑acetyl enamide with a gem‑dimethyl substituent and an additional methyl on the α‑carbon: CH₃‑CO‑NH‑C(=C(CH₃)₂)CH₃. The SMILES for this compound is **CC(=O)NC(=C(C)C)C**, which yields the correct formula and is consistent with the NMR data.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(=O)NC(=C(C)C)C</final_answer>
